text: Then it is my duty. <break time="0.8s" /> To break in that door. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Utterson. <break time="0.8s" /> Taking up the kitchen poker. <break time="0.8s" /> And Poole brought the axe from the laboratory. <break time="0.8s" /> Asked whether the masked thing was Mister Hyde. <break time="0.8s" /> Poole answered. <break time="0.8s" /> That it was the same size. <break time="0.8s" /> And had the same quick, light way of moving. <break time="0.8s" /> Utterson admitted that the sight of Hyde had always filled him. <break time="0.8s" /> With a strange, cold horror. <break time="0.8s" /> Which was exactly what Poole now described. <break time="0.8s" /> Two servants were sent around. <break time="0.8s" /> To guard the laboratorys back door. <break time="0.8s" /> Which opened onto a side street. <break time="0.8s" /> So that the creature could not escape. <break time="0.8s" /> In the dark laboratory the two men waited. <break time="0.8s" /> And from the cabinet above. <break time="0.8s" /> Came the sound of footsteps. <break time="0.8s" /> Pacing quietly up and down. <break time="0.8s" /> So it walks all day, sir. <break time="0.8s" /> Whispered Poole. <break time="0.8s" /> And once I heard it weeping. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a woman or a lost soul. <break time="0.8s" /> Jekyll, I demand to see you. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried Utterson loudly. <break time="0.8s" /> And if you will not let me in I will enter by force. <break time="0.8s" /> Utterson said the voice. <break time="0.8s" /> For Gods sake, have mercy. <break time="0.8s" /> And the lawyer shouted. <break time="0.8s" /> That is not Jekylls voice. <break time="0.8s" /> It is Hydes. <break time="0.8s" /> Down with the door, Poole. <break time="0.8s" /> Poole swung the axe. <break time="0.8s" /> And a scream of animal terror. <break time="0.8s" /> Rang from the cabinet. <break time="0.8s" /> The door shaking under each blow. <break time="0.8s" /> Until it fell inward at the fifth.
